levels.title: Check small even weights
levels.body_md: Take another look at how your program handles very small weights. What answer do you expect for the smallest even weight?
levels.question_back: What answer do you expect for the smallest even weight?

levels.title: Two positive even parts
levels.body_md: The key idea is splitting into two positive even parts. Think about the smallest total that allows this.
levels.question_back: What is the smallest total that can split into two positive even parts?

levels.title: Your condition looks right
levels.body_md: Your condition in `L6` with `w % 2 == 0` and `w > 2` already captures this idea. No failing input was found for your code.

levels.title: Why your logic works
levels.body_md: To split into two positive even parts, `w` must be even and at least `4`, since `2` is the smallest positive even number. Your check in `L6` returns `YES` exactly for even `w > 2` and `NO` otherwise, so `w = 2` correctly gives `NO` and `w = 4` and above give `YES` when even. No change is needed. This is `O(1)` time and memory.
